policy: Every requirement is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the ICP page named in source_roles. Figures are quoted, never restated.
structure_note: Green Residence has three eligibility categories — skilled workers, freelancers and self-employed individuals, and investors and business partners — each with its own requirements. Labels scope every rule to its category, because the salary threshold applies to skilled workers and the annual-income threshold to freelancers, and a flattened list would assert both of everyone.
freshness_note: The page publishes a dateline of 2026-08-20 and its body references 2026.
not_extracted: Fees. The page names no amounts.

Family sponsorship conditions. The page says holders may sponsor spouse and children 'in accordance with the approved requirements' without stating those requirements, so nothing is recorded about them.

requirements.label: Five years, renewable, no sponsor
requirements.description: Green Residence runs for five years with the option of renewal and, unlike most UAE work residences, does not require a sponsoring employer.
requirements.source_excerpt: green residence is one of the uae’s long-term residence categories. it is granted for a period of five years, with the option of renewal, and enables holders to live and work in the uae without the need for a sponsor.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Green Residence is one of the UAE’s long-term residence categories. It is granted for a period of five years, with the option of renewal, and enables holders to live and work in the UAE without the need for a sponsor.

requirements.label: Skilled workers: a valid UAE employment contract
requirements.description: The first of four conditions for the skilled-worker category.
requirements.source_excerpt: the applicant must have a valid employment contract within the uae.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The applicant must have a valid employment contract within the UAE.

requirements.label: Skilled workers: occupational classification levels 1–3
requirements.description: Against the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation's approved classification.
requirements.source_excerpt: a professional classification from levels 1 to 3, in accordance with the approved occupational classification of the ministry of human resources and emiratisation.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A professional classification from levels 1 to 3, in accordance with the approved occupational classification of the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation.

requirements.label: Skilled workers: bachelor's degree or higher
requirements.description: The authority states a floor, not a specific field.
requirements.source_excerpt: hold a qualification of no less than a bachelor's degree.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Hold a qualification of no less than a bachelor's degree.

requirements.label: Skilled workers: AED 15,000 monthly minimum
requirements.description: A monthly figure, and it applies to the skilled-worker category only.
requirements.source_excerpt: meet a minimum monthly salary requirement of aed 15,000 or its equivalent in foreign currencies.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Meet a minimum monthly salary requirement of AED 15,000 or its equivalent in foreign currencies.

requirements.label: Freelancers: a freelance or self-employment permit
requirements.description: Issued by the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation.
requirements.source_excerpt: hold a freelance work permit or a self-employment permit issued by the ministry of human resources and emiratisation.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Hold a freelance work permit or a self-employment permit issued by the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation.

requirements.label: Freelancers: bachelor's degree, specialised diploma or equivalent
requirements.description: A wider qualification floor than the skilled-worker category allows.
requirements.source_excerpt: hold a qualification of no less than a bachelor's degree, specialised diploma, or equivalent.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Hold a qualification of no less than a bachelor's degree, specialised diploma, or equivalent.

requirements.label: Freelancers: proof of stable income or financial solvency
requirements.description: Required for the whole period of residence, not only at application.
requirements.source_excerpt: provide proof of stable annual income or financial solvency throughout the period of residence in the uae.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Provide proof of stable annual income or financial solvency throughout the period of residence in the UAE.

requirements.label: Freelancers: AED 360,000 annual income over the previous two years
requirements.description: An ANNUAL figure covering the previous two years — distinct from the skilled-worker monthly salary, and not interchangeable with it.
requirements.source_excerpt: the annual income from freelance work during the previous two years must not be less than aed 360,000 or its equivalent in foreign currencies.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The annual income from freelance work during the previous two years must not be less than AED 360,000 or its equivalent in foreign currencies.

requirements.label: Investors and business partners: proof of investment
requirements.description: Either an investment or a contribution to a business venture in the UAE.
requirements.source_excerpt: provide proof of investment or contribution to a business venture within the uae.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Provide proof of investment or contribution to a business venture within the UAE.

requirements.label: Investors and business partners: required licences and approvals
requirements.description: From the relevant authorities; the page does not enumerate which.
requirements.source_excerpt: obtain the necessary licences and approvals from the relevant authorities.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Obtain the necessary licences and approvals from the relevant authorities.
